notes: 神学谈话场景标题，译作复数概念而非单一异端。

translation: 已经循着文书线索查过
notes: 条件标签。
人名/神职称谓。

source: Nothing is private to the man on the threshold
notes: threshold 保留地点与处境双义，呼应窥入私人厨房。

source: The Book of Suns, the [[Church]]'s holiest text.
notes: Book of Suns 沿用前作定名《骄阳之书》；保留教会链接标识。

source: Perhaps if you asked extremely nicely
translation: 或许，只要你格外好声好气地求一求
notes: 保留一本正经的冷幽默。
与正文既定译句“上如是，下亦然”完全统一。
呼应轰雷之皮永不停息、维系存续的设定。

source: Philanthropist, collector, former Librarian of Hush House. Fraser Strathcoyne has long wished to embrace his inner Cross-nature. Now his wish is granted.
translation: 慈善家，收藏家，噤声居屋前任司书。弗雷泽·斯特拉思科因长久以来都想拥抱内在的介壳种本性。如今，他如愿以偿。
notes: Hush House 依术语表译“噤声居屋”；Cross-nature 依终审译“介壳种本性”。
人名/称谓。

source: 'Warsaw can no more be Tartar than Venice can be Teuton. Kings lose their pains and their honor in the attempt to make them so.'(Hugo)
translation: “华沙不可能变成鞑靼人的，正如威尼斯不可能变成日耳曼人的。国王们为此劳心劳力，也只会徒失颜面。”（雨果）
notes: 保留历史归属判断与讥刺语气。

source: Behold, I stand at the door and knock
notes: 沿《启示录》中文通行措辞。
与贝茜对话中反复出现的“What it is.”译法一致。
沿用《司辰之书》既有人名译法。
Thunderskin/Sign 依术语表译“轰雷之皮／征象”。

source: I've been thinking about St Stephen's Eve
translation: 我一直在思考圣斯德望节前夜
notes: 话题/条件标签。

source: Mason wants me to give him the Flowermaker's Sign, once I've recovered it from the temenos at Epirus.
translation: 梅森希望我从伊庇鲁斯圣域取回制花人的征象后，将它交给他。
notes: Flowermaker/Sign 依术语表译“制花人／征象”；temenos 暂译“圣域”。
角色/界面标签。

source: 'The whole night listened to the flute of Nectaire. Already the evening star was rising above the paling horizon.' (Anatole France)
translation: “整整一夜，都在聆听内克泰尔的笛声。暮星已从渐白的天际升起。”（阿纳托尔·法朗士）
notes: 保留引文的夜色与将晓意象。
人名。

source: Parish priest in the church of St Reparata in Antibes.
translation: 昂蒂布圣雷帕拉塔教堂的本堂神父。
notes: 人物短描述。
人名/称谓。

translation: 巴勃罗·毕加索，《扶手椅中的女人》，1941年（布面油画）
notes: 按画作铭牌格式处理。
借用福尔摩斯名篇标题句式，呼应圣吉内福尔故事中的狗。
场景对象名。
法语标题；与 Package: Honneur et Humanité 条目统一。

source: Mercy is found only in Shadow
notes: Shadow 与场所类别“暗影之地”照应，保留箴言式语气。

source: It Is Not Permitted To You
notes: 场景是修道院秘处的神秘禁令；不擅自具体化为普通“入内”标牌。

source: "That sweet city, with her screaming choirs" (Crispin)
translation: “那座甜美的城，她有尖啸的唱诗班”（克里斯平）
notes: 保留对牛津传统称颂的怪诞改写。

source: An old comrade-in-arms from my Légion days. Almost irrepressibly cheerful.
translation: 我在军团时期的老战友。快活得几乎压不住。
notes: Légion 在人物短描述中简译“军团”。

translation: 马蒂斯描述了秘密办公室
notes: 条件标签。
Withering 依系统术语译“凋萎”；任务/条件标签。
英语惯用语兼指信封中的应急储备，保留双义。

source: Spencer's tailor before the Wars. Much older now, but still a man you could trust with a needle, even where a gentleman does not generally permit needles.
translation: 诸战以前替斯宾塞裁衣的人。如今老了许多，针线仍值得托付——哪怕要落针的地方，绅士通常不许针靠近。
notes: 保留裁衣、身体与绅士体面的含蓄笑话。
专名音译。

source: The last of the generous god
notes: 无上下文称号。

source: The libraire of the Librairie des Heures in Antibes.
translation: 昂蒂布司辰书店的书商。
notes: 保留两处富文本；Librairie des Heures 暂译“司辰书店”。
保留原题逗号造成的货品标签腔与战时进口物资语感。

source: Ela wants me to give her the Sun-in-Rags' Sign, once I've recovered it from the temenos at Cracow.
translation: 艾拉希望我从克拉科夫圣域取回残阳的征象后，将它交给她。
notes: Sun-in-Rags/Sign 依术语表译“残阳／征象”；temenos 暂译“圣域”。
对应牡鹿王神圣脚本，以寓言式短标题处理。
话题/条件标签。
Withering 依系统术语译“凋萎”。
Flowermaker/Sign 依术语表译“制花人／征象”。
Dead 依术语表译“死者”。

source: Thousands have lived without love, not one without water
translation: 千万人无爱而生，无一人无水而活
notes: W. H. 奥登名句，保留对举。

source: Moment of connection over a cigarette
notes: 关系条件标签保持简短，不把片刻共鸣扩写成已经结下情谊。

translation: 雷帕拉塔就是双生巫女
notes: Sister-and-Witch 依术语表译“双生巫女”；条件标签。

source: A dream of my past troubles me. I'll feel better if I can talk it out.
translation: 往昔的梦令我不安。若能把它说出来，我会好受些。
notes: 无上下文状态说明。

source: 'My duty is to heal my patients. But my methods are my own'
translation: “我的职责是治愈病人。但用什么方法，由我决定。”
notes: 保留奥比耶医生的职业自负与危险暗示。
人名音译。

translation: 一道慵懒的幽海蓝存在。
notes: inframarine 疑为有意仿 ultramarine 的新造色名，暂译“幽海蓝”并保留超自然 presence 的含混。
作为冰箱场景标题，兼具物资稀缺时代的认真与轻微夸张。

source: An Introduction to Miss Naenia: for an Opportunity
translation: 引见奈尼娅小姐：为了一个机会
notes: 任务标题。
修会称谓与专名音译。
人名音译。

source: I think of myself as a priest, first
translation: 我首先把自己视作神父
notes: 话题/分支标签。

source: A grande dame of the old school, often found on the sunny side of the park in Antibes.
translation: 一位旧派贵妇，常在昂蒂布公园向阳的一侧出现。
notes: grande dame 译“贵妇”，保留旧时代气质。
仪式制作物标签，与 Hallow/Unveil 并列，暂译“驱离”。

source: An elegant gentleman with a golden smile.
translation: 一位优雅的绅士，笑容如金。
notes: 无上下文人物短描述。

source: Mansus painting was from Hush House
translation: 漫宿画作来自噤声居屋
notes: Mansus/Hush House 依术语表译“漫宿／噤声居屋”；条件标签。
人名；源文尾随空格不进入显示译文。
Flowermaker 依术语表译“制花人”；Temenos 暂译“圣域”。

source:
IN BIBLIOTHECA CORVORUM RUTILA MEMORIA SEPULTA

In the library of ravens, a buried memory of gold and red
translation:
IN BIBLIOTHECA CORVORUM RUTILA MEMORIA SEPULTA

群鸦的图书馆中，埋藏着一段金红记忆
notes: 拉丁题铭原样保留；严格保留两处换行与三处回车。
昵称音译。

source: Where the fishes come to knock on it / And listen
translation: 鱼儿游来敲击它 / 并侧耳聆听
notes: 引文题辞；保留斜线结构及 fishes 指向鱼而非敲门的人。

source:
'So grand, so solemn, so vast! And yet so delicate, so airy, so graceful!' (Twain)
'The Cathedral is an awful failure...everything is vile in it.' (Wilde)
translation:
“如此宏伟，如此庄严，如此广大！却又如此精巧，如此轻盈，如此优美！”（马克·吐温）
“这座大教堂是个可怕的失败……其中一切都俗不可耐。”（王尔德）
notes: 保留两位作家对米兰大教堂的鲜明反差。

source: A bulky, sardonic woman with a jittery habit of dropping her eyes.
translation: 一位身材壮实、言语尖刻、总神经质地垂下眼睛的女人。
notes: 无上下文人物短描述。
结合衣柜场景，保留并列节奏。

source: Lt. Col. A.C Welland, Atlanta, 1865 (oil, canvas, unsigned)
translation: A.C. 韦兰德中校，亚特兰大，1865年（布面油画，未署名）
notes: 按画作铭牌格式处理；Welland 沿现有译名“韦兰德”。

source: Separate Not the Unity of Thy Word
notes: 仿经文题辞；Word 指圣言／Logos，Unity 呼应《骄阳之书》“分而不裂”的教义。避免“汝言”误作“你的言语”。
人名。
保持墨水条目标题的简短、庄重。
Dappled Rose 为结局专名，暂译“斑驳玫瑰”。
世界观专名/标题。

source: More than gold, less than sight
notes: 保留两段对称比较与 sight 的视觉意象。
Bewitching 依相邻批次系统术语译“惑心”。

source: Metallurgist, gourmet, corrupted immortal. Livid and blazing with a new power.
translation: 冶金师，美食家，堕落的不朽者。面色青紫，体内燃着一股新生的力量。
notes: 保留 livid 的青紫色与愤怒双义。
人名/军衔。
呼应让维耶镜中旧日店铺的记忆。

source:
IN HAC FIGURA VINCES
In this form shall you conquer
translation:
IN HAC FIGURA VINCES
你将以此形取胜
notes: 拉丁题铭原样保留；form 译“形”，保留形体与象征双义。

source: I've already supplemented his income once
notes: 条件标签，指先前给过马蒂斯钱。

source: An Introduction to Miss Naenia: for a Favour
translation: 引见奈尼娅小姐：为一份人情
notes: 任务标题；Favour 暂译“人情”。
Smooth 明指触感与表面状态；“光洁”会减弱如玻璃般平滑的直观意象。

source: Charmion von Wiegand, 'The Nuptial Form', 1947 (oil, canvas)
translation: 夏米恩·冯·维甘德，《婚仪之形》，1947年（布面油画）
notes: 按画作铭牌格式处理；作品名保留抽象画的形式意味。
开发测试标题，保留全大写所传达的夸张语气。
人名。
依术语表。
季节交替标题，保持简短口语。
Sun-in-Rags/Sign/Gleam 依术语表译“残阳／征象／烁”。

source: I can keep it for myself or render  it to someone else - once I've achieved it.
translation: 等我取得它，可以留给自己，也可以交给别人。
notes: 两个共用条目；源文 render 与 it 间双空格疑为笔误，译文不保留显示空格。

translation: AltFade 脉冲（淡出 -> 淡入）
notes: 保留技术标识 AltFade 与箭头。

source: 'We know what happened to those who chanced to meet the Great God Pan'
translation: “我们知道，那些偶遇大神潘的人遭遇了什么”
notes: 保留引文体及 Great God Pan 的古典称谓。
陶罐检查选项。
Hush House 依术语表译“噤声居屋”；条件标签。

source: A tight and vivid knife of a woman.
translation: 一个身形紧瘦、神采凌厉如刀的女人。
notes: 保留 woman as knife 的锐利比喻。

source: 'Turn on the dark, I'm afraid of the light'
notes: 保留 turn on the dark 的悖谬式冷幽默。
指向布尔沃-利顿小说《未来种族》，并呼应介壳种蜕变。

source: An embarrassingly simple use for the invisible arts
translation: 无形之术竟有如此简单、简直丢脸的用法
notes: 条件标签；保留用秘术找暗门的自嘲。
条件标签。

source: Autumn is dead you will remember
translation: 秋天已死 你要记住
notes: 引自阿波利奈尔《告别》；保留原句无标点、直接召唤记忆的诗形。

source: Nina has arranged a meeting with Miss Naenia, and in return, I've promised I'll fulfil the favour she'll ask of me.
translation: 宁娜已经安排我与奈尼娅小姐见面；作为回报，我答应完成她将要提出的那桩人情。
notes: 任务说明；Favour 暂译“人情”。
结合罗迪娅的绿意外貌与歌声般说话方式，保留人物题名感。
保留昆德拉书名联想及标本熊交互的反差。

source: It isn't the first time I've tried to convince her, either
translation: 这也不是我第一次试着说服她
notes: 条件标签。

source: Born on the Twenty-Eighth of June
notes: 保持传记式章节题语气。
对应激情“愤怒”，保留形容式问句。

translation: 得知西农布尔受困于此
notes: 条件标签。
i.75 新增对话选项标签；承接“找到后再回来”，保留口语感并保持简短。
对应激情“好奇”。
条件标签。
无上下文人物短描述。
条件标签。

source: Manuscript-hunter, legacy-scavenger... mercenary? Many would question his ethics; few would deny his acuteness.
translation: 手稿猎人，遗产拾荒者……佣兵？很多人质疑他的操守；没人怀疑他的敏锐。
notes: 保留职业枚举、停顿与道德评价。
专名；两个共用条目。

source: Now open your pockets, and give me my due
translation: 现在掏掏口袋，把该我的交出来
notes: 保留讨债者半戏谑半强硬的口吻。

source: [Sip casually from my drink, as if I hadn't heard anything.]
translation: [若无其事地啜一口酒，仿佛什么都没听见。]

source: Medea will introduce me to Miss Naenia - if I promise to listen to an opportunity she'll offer me.  I don't yet know what that might be.
translation: 美狄亚会引见我去见奈尼娅小姐——条件是，我得答应听听她要给我的某个机会。我还不知道那会是什么。
notes: 任务说明；保留 opportunity 未必善意的开放含义。

source: Clears any Exhibits from our desk interactions
translation: 清除书桌互动中的所有展品
notes: 开发/交互说明；Exhibits 暂译“展品”。
与后文询问霍布森作品相接，指书店中没有相关纸本。

source: A melancholy gawk of a man, but his gestures are fluid, his features expressive.
translation: 一个忧郁、笨拙得有些扎眼的男人，但动作流畅，神情丰富。
notes: 保留 gawk 将人物整体名词化的略带刻薄观察。
保留安德烈书店场景中的格言式引文。

source: A somnolent dangle of a cat.
translation: 一只睡眼惺忪、懒垂垂的猫。
notes: 保留 dangle 的松垮垂落感。
暂按秘史物品／状态名处理。

source: Meta, to distinguish from general narration
translation: 元叙事，用以区别普通旁白
notes: 内部界面说明。

translation: 亚伦·道格拉斯，《抱负》，1936年（布面油画）
notes: 按画作铭牌格式处理。
界面状态标签。
保留一本正经的微妙期待。
莎士比亚《暴风雨》语句，保留同义复沓。
界面状态标签。
按戏剧语汇处理：具名人物继而汇成群戏；不把 parts 误解为身体部位。
西班牙语题名；Torcedor 指手工卷制雪茄者。

source: There's a painting of the Mansus on display here
translation: 这里陈列着一幅描绘漫宿的画
notes: Mansus 按术语表译‘漫宿’；避免将地点画作误作人物画像。
界面状态标签。
称号标签。
与既有套装、订单和包裹名统一。

translation: 一个衣着招摇的年轻人

source: An imposing but quiet man. He moves deliberately and speaks with care.
translation: 一个气势逼人却沉默寡言的男人。举止从容审慎，说话字斟句酌。

notes: 专名暂音译。
法语人名暂译。

source: The sleekly smiling director of the Sanitarium Aujourd'hui.
translation: “今日”疗养院那位笑容圆滑的院长。
notes: Sanitarium Aujourd'hui 沿既有译名‘“今日”疗养院’。

source: Nina has arranged a meeting with Miss Naenia, and in return, I've promised to listen to the opportunity she'll offer me.
translation: 宁娜安排我与奈尼娅小姐见面；作为回报，我答应听听她要给我的那个机会。
notes: Nina 按术语表译‘宁娜’；保留 opportunity 未必善意的开放含义。

source: France is divided. Antibes is divided. The Axe is the [[Hour]] of division.
translation: 法国四分五裂。昂蒂布四分五裂。双角斧正是司掌分裂的[[Hour]]。
notes: 保留链接；Axe 暂译‘斧钺’，division 的政治与秘史双义均保留。
Sun-in-Rags/Sign 按术语表译“残阳／征象”。

source: A garrulous, cheery messenger from another age.
translation: 一位来自另一个时代、快活健谈的信使。

source: When the Sun's House is quiet
notes: House of the Sun 按前作术语作“太阳的居屋”；标题以题辞式短语收束。

source: 'Worm of Worms: My Portrait', Julian Coseley, 1924 (oil, panel)
translation: 《蠕虫之蠕虫：我的肖像》，朱利安·科赛利，1924年（板面油画）
notes: Worm 是本系列固定概念“蠕虫”；仿“王中之王”结构作“蠕虫之蠕虫”，采用藏品题签格式。

source: Try to lock me in, will you? Cretins.
translation: 还想把我锁在里面，是吗？蠢货。
notes: 保留挑衅与轻蔑口吻。
截取弥尔顿“只须站立静候，也是在服务”的名句；对应车站守候者，保留典故与冷讽。

source: What acttually counts as actually human these days anyway
translation: 如今究竟怎样才算真正的人类
notes: 保留原文 acttually 的随手拼写感，不在中文中另造错字。

source: Easier to silence music you know
translation: 熟悉的音乐更容易噤声
notes: 兼具技艺提示与略带威胁的语气。
对应激情“愤世嫉俗”。
Heart 是准则“心”；before 保留神话时间感。

translation: 认定圣雷帕拉塔就是双生巫女
notes: Sister-and-Witch 按术语表译‘双生巫女’。

translation: 确认与噤声居屋的关联
notes: Hush House 按术语表译‘噤声居屋’。

source:
TURPIS VERITAS PULCHRA QUAERENTIBUS
The truth, however ugly in itself, is always curious and beautiful to seekers after it. (Poirot)
translation:
TURPIS VERITAS PULCHRA QUAERENTIBUS
真相本身无论多么丑陋，对追寻它的人而言，总是奇妙而美丽。（波洛）
notes: 拉丁题铭原样保留，仅翻译英文释文。
状态标签。

source: Skilled dejection. A poet and car mechanic.
translation: 深谙消沉之道。诗人，兼汽车修理工。
notes: Skilled dejection 保留人物简介的冷幽默。

source:

[[Pain]] becomes [[Weariness]].

Weariness fades.

[[Traces]]是例外。有痕迹就无法入睡，睡眠也不会将其治愈——事实上，在同一地点连续睡上不止一晚，反而会留下痕迹。

source:
I left the Légion when my five years were done. I didn't think anything could be worse than the Rung Ma or Khorasan. So when the [[Bureau]] invited me back, I accepted.

It was at Gladwyn Lake - when I saw the foxfire in the crawling waters, when I saw the celebrant grow fruitful - I knew I'd been wrong. But we kept the lid on the worst of it, and they offered me another promotion. I knew the Bureau had changed, but I thought I could help change it back. And I very quickly grew used to the pay.
translation:
五年服役期满，我离开了军团。我原以为，世上不可能有比隆马或呼罗珊更糟的地方。所以[[Bureau]]邀我回去时，我答应了。

是在格拉德温湖——看见狐火浮在蠕行的水面，看见主祭者身上结出果实——我才知道自己错了。不过，我们压住了最坏的事态，他们也又给了我一次晋升。我知道防剿局已经变了，却以为自己能帮它变回原样。当然，我也很快便习惯了那份薪水。

Driving qualities that help you decide your goals. You start with one - you can develop another two.

Increase your Passions with [[Experiences]], and they'll add more pips to your [[Aspect Pool]]. Whenever you act with a Passion, it'll refresh a pip of every relevant [[Aspect]] in your Pool. To put it simply: increasing your Passions, and acting with them, helps you pass checks on skills which match the Passion.

But people change. That's called character development; trauma; disillusionment; experience.

So if your actions recently have drifted another way, you can spend your [[Experiences]] to evolve one Passion into another when you level it up.
translation:
驱使你前行、帮助你决定目标的特质。开始时你拥有一项，之后还能发展两项。

用[[Experiences]]提升心念，它们便会为[[Aspect Pool]]增加点数。每次依循一项心念行事，池中所有相关[[Aspect]]都会恢复一点。简单说，提升心念并依循它们行事，会让你更容易通过与心念相符的技艺检定。

但人总会改变。这叫人物成长；创伤；幻灭；经验。

所以，若你近来的行为转向别处，升级心念时便可花费[[Experiences]]，将一项心念演化为另一项。
notes: 保留全部链接与段落；第三段维持元叙事式干幽默。
选择标签。
保留第一人称立场下的刻薄判断。

source: The Carapace Cross is gone. Into earth; into flesh; and the travelling-kinds, beyond wave and sky. They are very few now under the earth, and the Cross-in-flesh are us - some of us, at least... The hybridity which we called the 'Carapace Cross' was gone, long and far. Their nature survived only in some bloodlines, and perhaps in the darkness beyond the sky. But since the wars...
translation: 介壳种已经离去。进入大地；进入血肉；行旅诸族则越过浪涛与天空。如今地底所余无几；血肉中的介壳种就是我们——至少，是我们中的一些人…… 我们称作“介壳种”的混合本性，早已去远。其本性只在少数血脉中留存，也许还在天空之外的黑暗里。但自诸战以来……
notes: 保留斜体、段落、末尾换行与未完预示；Carapace Cross 依终审译“介壳种”。

source: But when at last we came back to Cambray in '19... we won.
translation: 可当我们终于在一九一九年回到康布雷时……我们赢了。
notes: 保留第一人称群体记忆与胜利前的停顿。

source: I don't like to miss anything.
translation: 我不喜欢错过任何东西。
notes: 保留第一人称执拗。

source: What's random, what's fair? If you roll a ten-sided die a hundred times and get a 1 every time, is that fair? You can roll a die a hundred times and get the same result every time. So Travelling doesn't use dice - it draws tokens, each numbered 1 to 10, from a bag. When the bag is empty, we put the tokens back in and shake the bag. There's more than one tile with each number, so you can get the same number a few times in a row. But your luck will always turn. When you reload after a save, we always put all the tokens back in and shake it. This means, bluntly, that you can save-scum. You can change this in Options. "Then said Fate to Chance: "Let us play our old game again." And they played it again together, using the gods as pieces, as they had played it oft before." - Lord Dunsany, Time and the Gods
translation: 何谓随机，何谓公平？若将一枚十面骰连掷一百次，次次都是 1，这也算公平吗？ 你的确可能连掷一百次骰子，而每次结果都相同。所以《夜游漫记》不用骰子——游戏会从袋中抽取编号 1 至 10 的筹片。袋子一空，我们便把筹片全部放回，再摇一摇。每个数字都有不止一枚筹片，所以连续几次抽到同一个数字并不稀奇。但你的运气迟早会变。 读取存档时，我们总会把所有筹片放回袋中，再摇一摇。说白了，这表示你可以反复读档刷结果。这一点可在“选项”中更改。 “随后，命运对机运说：‘让我们再玩一次那古老的游戏。’祂们便再次同玩，以诸神为棋子，正如从前屡次所为。”——邓萨尼勋爵，《时间与诸神》
notes: 继承旧 TAN-444640F930E3 的命运／机运译名、游戏标题和读档冷幽默；按 i.75 改稿删去骨筹／银筹插话及首尾旧引文，压缩段落，并将保留的邓萨尼引文移至末段。斜体、粗体及四段双换行与新版源文一致。

source: Oh yes. Difficult to turn your back on these.
translation: 哦，是啊。这些东西很难让人视而不见。
notes: 保留第一人称难以抗拒的意味。

source: Temples of ice, cobbies gleaming amber, knives of nerveless acuteness, a cage of coral... [[Ys]]-behind-the-wave... where for endless agonised days they stretched me behind bars. Ys the city unprecedented, whose slow bells heard above the sea might strike the [[Hours]]... none can go living to Ys, and I was not living when I went there. Still less when they cut the [[Worms]] from me. Still less when they cut out my heart.
translation: 冰之神殿，琥珀闪耀的鹅卵石，锐利而无知觉的刀，一座珊瑚牢笼……浪涛之后的[[Ys]]……他们把我在栅栏后拉展开来，痛苦的日子无休无止。伊斯，前所未有之城；海面之上若听见它迟缓的钟声，或许连[[Hours]]也会被敲响……活人不得去伊斯；我去时已非活人。他们从我体内割出[[Worms]]时，更不像。剜去我的心时，更不必说。
notes: 保留三处链接、第一人称受刑记忆及 strike Hours 的钟鸣／伤害双义；结合本批后文 amber-shining cobbles，将 cobbies 按鹅卵石处理。

translation: 醒时世界边缘那片争议地带。它属于[[Duties]]所辖，尤受[[Légion]]关注。有些权威认为，边区就是[[Wake]]与[[Mansus]]之间的边境。
notes: 保留四处链接；Marches/Bounds 分别译‘边区／边境’。

source:
If only life came with [[Footnotes]]!


Once you've viewed a [[Footnote]], you can always find it by searching for its name via Footnote search - which you're looking at now, because that's the only way to get here.


Most [[Footnotes]] come with opportunities for reflection, self-expression, or angst, allowing you to choose an [[Experience]]. You don't have to make the choice straight away - the Footnotes finder will track and remind you of [[Footnotes]] with incomplete choices.
translation:
要是人生也附带[[Footnotes]]就好了！


查看过某条[[Footnote]]后，随时都可在脚注搜索中按名称找到它——你眼下看的正是脚注搜索，因为只有这样才能来到这里。


大多数[[Footnotes]]都提供反思、自我表达或焦虑的机会，让你选择一项[[Experience]]。不必当场决定；脚注查找器会记录那些尚未完成选择的[[Footnotes]]，并提醒你。
notes: 保留全部链接与三换行段隔；维持系统说明的元叙事玩笑。
保留第一人称偏好。

source: Not many young men left in Brancrug after the war.
translation: 大战之后，布兰库格没剩下多少年轻男人。
notes: 保留个人观察中战争留下的空缺。

source: Subtle [[Footnotes]] only appear in dialogue until you've viewed them, and resolved any choices they offer you. Then they stop bothering you unless you actually search for them. This is our recommended approach. We don't want to patronise you, or badger you with information you already know. But if you're really worried about missing a Footnote, you can turn Subtle Footnotes off, and they'll always appear in dialogue no matter how many times you've viewed them.
translation: 隐微[[Footnotes]]只会在你尚未查看、也尚未处理其中选择时出现在对话里。此后，它们便不会再来烦你，除非你主动搜索。这是我们推荐的方式。我们不想居高临下地指点你，也不想拿你已经知道的信息反复纠缠。 不过，如果你实在担心漏掉脚注，也可以关闭隐微脚注。这样一来，无论已经看过多少次，它们都会始终出现在对话中。
notes: 保留粗体、链接、段落与直接对玩家说话的克制语气。
秘史系统概念暂译‘职责’。

source: Is Trieste Italian, or Yugoslavian? The Free Territory is a temporary answer to that question, but it's proving less temporary than anyone wanted, The Ministries and the Incorporates can't agree on a governor. Stamps are printed in two languages. The unhappy compromise continues, but at least no-one's shooting.
translation: 的里雅斯特属于意大利，还是南斯拉夫？自由区暂时回答了这个问题，可事实证明，它‘暂时’得比任何人想要的都久。部委与集团无法就总督人选达成一致。邮票以两种语言印制。这场不愉快的妥协仍在继续；但至少没人开枪。
notes: 保留地缘政治僵局与末句苦涩宽慰；Ministries/Incorporates 按术语表译‘部委／集团’。

source: from whom nothing more can be taken; who cannot be deceived; who calls the dead by name. Sometimes called the Ivory Dove. Not the kindest of the [[Aviform]] [[Hours]], but never cruel. He's always remembered what the world forgets. [[Long]] who ascend under the Elegiast have been called 'ghouls'. This isn't very nice, but they do in fact break open graves to feast on the memories of dead flesh.
translation: 其身再无可夺之物； 不可受欺； 逐名召唤死者。 有时被称作象牙鸽。祂并非[[Aviform]] [[Hours]]中最仁慈的一位，却从不残酷。世界遗忘的事，祂始终记得。 在悼歌诗人座下升华的[[Long]]，有人称之为‘食尸鬼’。这称呼不太友善，不过他们确实会掘开坟墓，享用死去血肉中的记忆。
notes: 保留斜体、链接、全部换行与悼歌诗人冷峻而非残酷的区分。
保留与其他分支拼合的片段结构。

source:
"When the Sun-in-Splendour was divided, its Names fractured too." 

The Names of the [[Hours]], are their major servants, or aspects, or emanations. Some, perhaps all, Names were previously [[Long]].

[[Mansus]]-spirits often like to tell gullible mortals they're Names. Who's going to quibble?
translation:
‘骄阳被分裂时，祂的具名者也一同破碎。’ 

[[Hours]]的具名者，是祂们最重要的仆从、侧面或流溢。有些，或许全部，具名者从前都是[[Long]]。

[[Mansus]]灵体往往喜欢哄骗轻信的凡人，说自己是具名者。谁还会跟它们争辩真假？
notes: Sun-in-Splendour/Name 按术语表译‘骄阳／具名者’；保留全部链接与末句讥诮。 破折号专项终审：改用更适合中文的逗号、括号或分号。

notes: 保留第一人称式的自我开解。

translation: [[Hours]]的秩序虽有瑕疵，却维系着时间、理性与对称……
notes: 保留链接与对旧秩序带保留的怀念。
保留预言片段与未完句。

source: The Church of the Unconquerable [[Sun]] acknowledges four [[Horae]] Canonicae, but its outer rites and doctrines present a humanised, comfortable version of each. The earliest church councils resolved that the inner mysteries of the Hours are much too dangerous to be approached directly. They're right, of course - most of all, about the mysteries of one particular Hour.
translation: 无敌[[Sun]]教会承认四位正典[[Horae]]，但其外层礼仪与教义，为每一位都披上了人性化、令人安心的外衣。最早的教会会议裁定，司辰的内在奥秘过于危险，绝不可直接接近。当然，他们是对的——尤其是在某一位特定司辰的奥秘上。
notes: Church of the Unconquerable Sun 对齐“无敌太阳教会”；Horae Canonicae 译“正典司辰”，保留 Sun、Horae 链接与斜体。

source:
Brancrug the village, and Brancrug Isle, which sits in a hollow of the Cornish coast like a pupil in an eye. [[Hush House]] stands there: a secret library, a hidden hospital, a sanctuary of peace and healing.

I was the parish priest of Brancrug for almost three years. I didn't exactly lose my faith.
translation:
布兰库格村，以及布兰库格岛——它坐落在康沃尔海岸的一处凹陷里，像瞳孔嵌在眼睛中。[[Hush House]]就矗立在那里：一座秘密图书馆，一所隐秘医院，一处和平与疗愈的庇护所。

我曾担任布兰库格的本堂神父，将近三年。我并不算真的失去了信仰。
notes: 保留链接、瞳孔意象与末句对信仰状态的含混自述。

notes: 保留两处链接。

translation: 我曾短暂向往跻身铸之长生者。但后来，我得知他们会何等残酷地碾碎竞争者。
notes: 保留第一人称向往转为退却；crushed 同时呼应铸造力量与竞争。

沿后续批次已采用的司辰译名。

translation: 难道全都那么糟？真有那么糟？从来如此？
notes: 保留连续自问与迟疑。

translation: 不可使其失衡者； 平息并镇静者； 先于太阳而来者 那位[[Uncounted]][[Hour]]，曾以辉耀女士之姿出现在[[Church]]圣像中；尸身交付烈火或大地时，人们便祈请Mater Solvens。

source: I've changed so much since those days...
translation: 自那些日子以来，我已经变了太多……
notes: 保留第一人称回望与未尽之意。

source: Imagine a ray that descends from an infinitely distant source of pure light. Imagine it passes through a series of prisms, each of which refract it into sub-rays and child-hues, but that the ray continues with its essential quality unchanged, until it ends as the thought you're having right now. Except it's not light, they're not prisms or colours, and the idea that the ray has a direction is complicated.
translation: 想象一道光，从无限遥远的纯光源头降下，穿过一连串棱镜。每一枚棱镜都将它折作支流与子色，可光的本质始终不变，直至尽头，化作你此刻的念头。只不过，它不是光；那些也不是棱镜或颜色；说这道光有方向，也颇为复杂。
notes: 保留层层流溢的比喻，并维持末句撤回比喻的学究式幽默。
与 Key/Edge 两项选择并列。

source: An early lesson still pains me.
translation: 早年学到的一课，至今仍让我隐隐作痛。
notes: 保留第一人称创伤。

source: For five years I fought beside the Legionnaires in the [[Marches]], patching wounds and treating fevers. Afterwards I became 'libéré' - honourably discharged. Those who survived, likewise. Others died. I couldn't save them.
translation: 五年里，我与[[Marches]]的军团士兵并肩作战，包扎伤口，治疗热病。后来，我成了‘libéré’——光荣退伍。活下来的人也一样。其他人死了。我没能救他们。
notes: 保留链接、法语身份词与末两句沉重的幸存者愧疚。
与 Ysiens: Elegant 构成态度分支。

source: Did she carry her artificial eye upwards, to the [[Glory]]?
translation: 她带着那只假眼，一同升向[[Glory]]了吗？
notes: 保留链接与第一人称推测。

source:
"One, Great, and Free." The Caudillo in Madrid has made good on the first boast, but the other two are nowhere within reach. Still, things may be looking up for this kingless kingdom. The Darlan regime in the French [[State]] has opened the border again. The [[Incorporates]] are ready to overlook old sins in the fight against [[Icarianism]]. The  frost begins to thaw.

Spain stayed out of the Wars - it has less need of [[Gleam]] or [[Corona]] - and there is something else here - a high host that visits select doors in the deep night. The scent of burning wax goes before it.
translation:
‘统一、伟大、自由。’马德里的考迪罗实现了第一句夸口，另两项却仍遥不可及。不过，这个无王的王国或许正渐有起色。法国[[State]]的达尔朗政权重新开放了边境。[[Incorporates]]愿意在对抗[[Icarianism]]时对旧罪睁一只眼闭一只眼。冰霜开始消融。

西班牙置身诸战之外——它不那么需要[[Gleam]]或[[Corona]]——这里还有别的东西：一支高天之军，会在深夜造访被选中的门。燃蜡的气味先它而至。
notes: 保留五处链接、政治宣传口号及末段超自然预示；high host 暂译‘高天之军’，不明说其性质。

source: The lovely chaos we call the [[Wood]].
notes: 保留链接与 lovely/chaos 的并置。

source: who cannot harm you; who cannot find you; who always has what you desire. The Flowermaker, born from the sparks of delight of the [[Forge of Days]], fallen like seeds into shadowed soil. The Flowermaker offered us the glittering prizes we most desired - even when our desires were concealed from us. A dead [[Hour]]; dead and buried.
translation: 不能伤害你者； 不能找到你者； 永远持有你所欲之物者。 制花人诞生于[[Forge of Days]]欣悦的火花；那些火花如种子般落入暗影土壤。制花人曾将我们最渴望的闪亮奖赏递到面前——哪怕那些欲望连我们自己都不知道。 一位死去的[[Hour]]；已死，且已入土。
notes: Flowermaker 按术语表译‘制花人’；保留标签、链接与诱惑中潜藏威胁的语气。

source: The [[Hours]] used to war over which History was real, and braid them together into a future. Perhaps it's not up to them any more.
translation: [[Hours]]曾为哪一段历史才是真实而争战，又将诸史编结成一个未来。也许现在，已经不再由祂们作主。
notes: 保留链接与第一人称式推测；braid 译‘编结’。

source: Not all knowledge is equal, but all knowledge is knowledge.
translation: 知识不尽相等，但知识终究是知识。
notes: 保留近乎格言式的重复。

source: The Bureau changed, and the Bureau changed me.
translation: 防剿局变了；防剿局也改变了我。
notes: 保留第一人称与两次 Bureau 的重复。

source:
On the rare occasion than an [[Hour]] truly dies, what remains it is laid to rest in a temenos, a sacred place beneath the [[Wake]], a secret precinct of [[Nowhere]], sealed by law and art and nature.

Who laid the stones of the temenoi? Who lays the Hours to rest there? What else lies within? I can answer only the third question: the [[Sign]] of that Hour. I know, too, that because of what I was and what I became, I am one of the very few who might be able to open the temenos seals.
translation:
一位[[Hour]]真正死去的情形极少。一旦发生，遗存会被安葬在圣域：[[Wake]]之下的圣地，[[Nowhere]]的隐秘辖境，由律法、技艺与本性共同封闭。

谁垒起诸圣域的石头？谁将司辰葬入其中？其中还藏着什么？我只能回答第三问：那位司辰的[[Sign]]。我还知道，正因我从前之所是、后来之所成，我是极少数或许能开启圣域封印的人。

source: The pre-eminent form of socialism in the twentieth century, based on the common ownership of the resources of creation. From the dream of a European radical, to an efflorescence of Utopian communities and revolutionary movements, to the system on which the [[Ministries]] founded their power.
translation: 二十世纪最显赫的社会主义形态，以创造资源公有为基础。它从一位欧洲激进分子的梦想，开花为乌托邦社区与革命运动，最终成为[[Ministries]]奠定权力的制度。
notes: 保留链接；efflorescence 译‘开花’，呼应世界观中政治与有机异变的双重意象。

source: These were the years I drifted fleshless through the Bounds, thin as rain, empty as a soap-bubble. The bright places of the Bel Ilai, the labhites' hunting-grounds, the sluggish silver sea. And I was cold - I was always cold - until I found my way back to warmth at the [[Stag Door]].
translation: 那些年里，我没有血肉，漂流在边境之中；薄如雨丝，空如肥皂泡。贝尔·伊莱的明亮之地，拉布希特的猎场，迟滞的银色海洋。而我很冷——我一直都那么冷——直到终于在[[Stag Door]]找回通往温暖的路。
notes: 保留链接、第一人称漂流感及 cold 重复；Bel Ilai/labhites 暂音译。
沿既有技艺分类译名。

source: Fires in churches - the golden blood of the Carapace-kind on my mouth and my hands. It wasn't exactly me - it was my passengers - but the difference was less clear each day. And so I had to go somewhere else. Beneath [[Hush House]], there was a door in a shining stone...
translation: 教堂里的火——我唇边、手上，都沾着介壳种的金色血液。那不完全是我干的——是我的乘客——可两者的界线一天比一天模糊。所以我不得不去往别处。[[Hush House]]地下，有一扇门嵌在发光的石头里……
notes: 与本批同段过往保持一致；保留链接及第一人称自我分辨逐渐崩解的语气。

source: In the Kingdom of Belgium, Charles of Flanders serves as regent. King Leopold III , accused of cowardice, of treason, and of improper marriage, is exiled and lost behind the frozen borders of Switzerland. Charles is temperate and competent. But he's very close to the British... and he caused a stir when he took his oath before the Combined Chambers in a candle-lit hemicycle.
translation: 在比利时王国，佛兰德的夏尔担任摄政。利奥波德三世国王被控怯懦、叛国与婚姻不当，流亡到瑞士冰封的边界之后，已不知所踪。夏尔稳健而称职。但他与英国人走得很近……而且，他在烛光照明的半圆形议厅里，面对两院联席会议宣誓时，还曾引起一阵骚动。
notes: 保留架空历史中‘烛光议厅’的异常技术细节。

source: I remember a night when Ghirbi wept again. I scooped up his tears of molten brass in my cupped palm. In the dream, my skin peeled and blistered, but only in the dream.
translation: 我记得有一夜，吉尔比又哭了。我拢起手掌，接住他熔化黄铜般的泪。梦里，我的皮肤剥落、起泡——但仅仅是在梦里。
notes: 保留第一人称记忆、灼伤触感与末句刻意自我安慰。

source:
The first thing I saw, when I opened my new eyes in [[Alexandria]], was Stanislav's face. Before that, the first thing I knew was the scent of jasmine. But only once the agony of birth had begun to pass. No wonder infants scream.

By midnight I could move my hands. By morning I could speak. After three days, Stanislav still refused to tell me why they had brought me back. 'Be grateful,' was all he would say. And, eventually, I was - once the pain had soaked into memory like water into sand.
translation:
我在[[Alexandria]]睁开新眼睛时，首先看见的是斯坦尼斯拉夫的脸。在那之前，我最先意识到的是茉莉花香——但那是在诞生的剧痛开始消退以后。难怪婴儿总要尖叫。

到午夜，我已经能活动双手。到清晨，我已经能说话。三天后，斯坦尼斯拉夫仍不肯告诉我，他们为什么把我带回来。‘心怀感激吧。’他只肯说这一句。而最终，我确实感激了——等痛苦像水渗入沙子一样，渗进记忆以后。
notes: 保留链接、第一人称重生体验、婴儿类比及末句痛苦沉淀的意象。

source: The [[Hours]] always determined what [[Histories]] persisted. But the Librarians of the [[Watchman's Tree]] were known to make determinations in their Great Inks. Perhaps they don't, not any more.
translation: [[Hours]]向来裁定哪些[[Histories]]得以延续。但据说，[[Watchman's Tree]]的司书也能用伟大墨水作出裁定。也许如今，他们已经不能了。
notes: 保留三个链接、原有顺序与末句不确定推测；Great Inks 暂沿本项目译‘大墨’。

source:
"Hours don't dream. Long try not to."

Mortals who gained immortality through devotion to a [[Principle]], in service to an [[Hour]], are called Long. Most were formerly counted among the [[Know]]. Possibly some were never mortal.

Few remain. Those with dead or [[Uncounted]] patron [[Hours]] are now '[[remortals]]'.
translation:
‘司辰不会做梦。长生者竭力不做。’

凡人若献身于一项[[Principle]]、侍奉一位[[Hour]]，并因此获得不朽，便称为长生者。大多数长生者从前都位列[[Know]]。也许有些从来就不是凡人。

如今所剩无几。庇主已经死去、或属于[[Uncounted]][[Hours]]的那些，如今成了‘[[remortals]]’。
notes: 保留全部链接；Long/Know 按术语表译‘长生者／通晓者’，remortals 周边按返凡语境处理但链接本身不改。

source: Only the approved candidates get to stand in elections. The larger cities have Star-shards inset now. The Red Army is here on the ground, protecting supply lines to Germany and enforcing their order. But not everything is going the [[Ministries]]' way. There's a factional battle between the home-grown [[Icarians]] and the Advisory Entity's people. The Nest tendency of the [[Cross]] - feral and uncompromising - has manifested across the south. And the cursed soldiers in the forests have recovered a bloody Oath from the earth.
translation: 只有获准的候选人才能参选。如今，较大的城市都嵌入了星辰碎片。红军驻扎在这里，保护通往德国的补给线，也强制推行自己的秩序。但并非一切都遂[[Ministries]]之愿。本土[[Icarians]]与顾问实体的人马正忙于内斗。[[Cross]]那野蛮而绝不妥协的巢穴倾向，已在南方各处显现。森林里的受诅士兵，也从大地中找回了一则血腥誓言。
notes: 保留三个链接；Nest/Oath 作为资本化设定暂译‘巢穴倾向／血腥誓言’，不作百科解释。

source:
The 'Threshold Legion', founded in service of the [[Duties]] to guard the edges of things. Almost anyone - or anything - is accepted as a recruit, as long as they're prepared to endure the training and abandon their old lives.

After three years service, recruits who survive may apply (a) for citizenship of a sponsoring nation and (b) if necessary, to be considered formally human.

The Légion's motto is 'Honneur et Humanité'. Its unofficial motto, more often cited by legionnaires, is 'sue, ou saigne!' - 'sweat, or bleed!'
translation:
“门槛军团”为履行[[Duties]]、守卫万物边缘而成立。几乎任何人——或任何东西——都可获准入伍，只须熬过训练，抛弃旧日生活。

服役三年后，幸存的新兵可申请：(a) 取得某个资助国的公民身份；以及 (b) 在必要时，被正式认定为人类。

军团的格言是“Honneur et Humanité”。军团士兵更常挂在嘴边的非正式格言则是“sue, ou saigne!”——“流汗，否则流血！”

source:
It's difficult to explain Harvey Hattington to those who haven't met him.. He claimed to have consumed the only extant copy of the Fire-Circle Tantra, with butter and garlic. He claimed to have eavesdropped on the Roost of the [[Aviform]] Hours. He would go into the kitchen garden of the House and return with what he claimed were 'transcriptions' of his chats with the bees.

The only verifiable fact about Hattington was that he'd flown with the RFC, and been decorated after he came down behind enemy lines. But he never would talk about that.
translation:
很难向没见过哈维·哈廷顿的人解释他。他声称，自己曾把世上仅存的《火环密续》就着黄油和大蒜吃掉；声称偷听过[[Aviform]]司辰的栖巢；还会走进居屋的菜园，回来时带着所谓他与蜜蜂谈话的“誊本”。

关于哈廷顿，唯一可核实的是：他曾在皇家飞行队服役，并因迫降敌后获颁勋章。可那件事，他从来不肯谈。
notes: 保留链接、三次荒诞声称与末段真实战功形成的反差；Fire-Circle Tantra 暂译《火环密续》。

source: The Romanian People's Republic is an Icarian state... but there are no Star-fragments here. Though King Michael is gone, the other Michael, the Messenger who writes in invisible blood, the dead-guide for whom candles are lit - that Michael is seen every day in Cluj, in paintings, mirrors, chalk. A power walks that has nothing to do with Gleam.
translation: 罗马尼亚人民共和国是一个伊加利亚派邦国……但这里没有星辰碎片。米哈伊国王虽已离去，另一个米迦勒却仍在——以无形之血书写的信使，人们为之点燃蜡烛的亡者向导。每天，克卢日都有人看见他：在画中，在镜里，在粉笔痕迹间。某种与烁毫无关系的力量，正在行走。
notes: 保留两位 Michael 的并置、宗教意象与末句对 Gleam 的否定；不擅自说明力量来源。

source: 'Dreamers and the Dead pass the White Door, but they must abandon their shapt, that part of the soul which speaks - like a key in the door, or a sword outside a king's hall.' The White Door is the lowest point of access to the [[Mansus]]. When I was young, even uninitiated dreamers might visit it by accident. It is much too dangerous for that now.
translation: ‘梦者与死者穿过纯白之门，但必须舍弃自己的铭晓，也就是灵魂中负责言说的部分——如同将钥匙留在门里，或将宝剑留在国王厅堂之外。’ 纯白之门是通往[[Mansus]]的最低入口。我年轻时，就连未经启蒙的梦者也可能误入那里。如今，它已经危险得绝不容许这种事发生。
notes: shapt 沿用《司辰之书》九大魂质的既有译名“铭晓”；保留斜体与链接；White Door 译“纯白之门”。
